title: Minex's Props
description: Ever wanted to add decorations using cool props? Well This datapack has got you covered! It adds 28 new props to ur existing worlds.
body: Ever wanted to add cool props to your minecraft world all in vanilla minecraft? Well this datapack has got you covered! This adds crafting recipes for 28 new props AND a recipe for Invisible Item frames, so you can display them in a better way. (NOTE: THIS REQUIRES A RESOURCE PACK CALLED "MINEX'S PROPS ASSETS")
